scientific_integrity: Finite results follow from a complete integer arithmetic certificate with explicit geometric reduction and independent cut/Walsh calculations; no independent external validation is represented.
scientific_limitations: Complete signed Walsh spectrum and optimal projection norm are only established for octagon quadrangulations. Decagon assertion covers zero-free multipliers and sharp gap, not its full spectrum; no claim for all higher polygon orders. Priority against an unindexed graph cut-polynomial census remains uncertain.
title: Exact Fourier singularity and optimal range projection for octagon quadrangulations
